content.title: MillerKnoll’s (NASDAQ:MLKN) Q4 CY2025: Beats On Revenue
content.summary: Office furniture manufacturer MillerKnoll (NASDAQ:MLKN) reported Q4 CY2025 results beating Wall Street’s revenue expectations, but sales fell by 1.6% year on year to $955.2 million. On top of that, next quarter’s revenue guidance ($943 million at the midpoint) was surprisingly good and 3.7% above what analysts were expecting. Its non-GAAP profit of $0.43 per share was 7.5% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
